description: This header file declares functions related to overlay loading in a C++ project. It includes function prototypes for gathering overlay files and applying overlays to a database, and includes relevant headers for filesystem operations, logging, and database interaction.

methods.name: gatherOverlays
methods.description: Finds JSON overlay files in a specified directory and returns a list of their paths.

methods.name: applyOverlays
methods.description: Processes a list of overlay files, attempting to parse and merge them into the provided database.
